Completion evidence (all 7 ACs met):

- Landed: Gerrit change 1321, commit 1920dc9fe5 (merged to main 2026-08-03).
- B1 escalation: shared blast-radius helper beside route_criteria keys the bug tier on persisted non-test file_impact; covers precheck det_blocking lift + route_criteria full-set + batch-runner fan-in. Unit tests assert all three seams plus light-tier defaults (no file_impact, test-only impact) and untouched claim exemption.
- B2 Gerrit DET criterion: cross-host attestation read via opcert_from_record -> trusted_env_keyring(record principal) -> attest.opcert.verify_opcert -> compute_validity(profile=DEFAULT, kind=plan-review); plan-review anchor resolver derived per plan (terminal SIGNATURE event via attestation_kind + build_introducing_commit_map/resolve_position_commit). Pinned-foreign-env ACCEPTED case unit-tested.
- Verdict predicate: ACCEPTED={certified, stale-code, stale-head}; FLAG=remaining plan-review-reachable compute_validity literals + {mismatch, key_not_valid_at_era, unknown_kind, unknown_scheme, invalid}; INFRA-FAIL-OPEN={unavailable, error, unknown-future}. Coverage test pins the union equality exactly (not-closed exclusion stated in-test).
- Non-test classification (tests/** + conftest.py excluded) stated + tested; threshold single constant BUGFIX_SIZE_THRESHOLD=150 imported by criterion and backtest.
- Backtest: scripts/backtest_bugfix_size.py over the 113-commit corpus -> artifact /tmp/backtest_planning_corpus.json; flagged set == the 13 adjudicated-substantive commits, 0 mechanical FPs (exact set equality asserted).
- Debug-skill Phase-1-exit review-plan sentence landed, coordinated with 78f1's writeback anchors.
